# 💫 About Me:
DevOps engineer with expertise in cloud infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, n8n) and observability stack implementation (Alloy, LGTM, OTEL). Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines, managing microservices architectures, and Linux system administration. Actively exploring ethical hacking methodologies, penetration testing techniques (legitimately, of course), and network security analysis using tools like Wireshark and Metasploit.
